connector.name: Proton Workflow Connector
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial self-hosted MCP connector for Proton Mail Bridge and SimpleLogin.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package proton-workflow-connector. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ntrpydev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_USERNAME
env.description: Bridge IMAP/SMTP username (from the Bridge app)

env.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_PASSWORD
env.description: Bridge-generated password (never your Proton account password)

env.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_EMAIL
env.description: Primary Proton address served by Bridge

env.name: SIMPLELOGIN_API_KEY
env.description: SimpleLogin API key; omit to disable alias tools
